This root chain frames a training engineering engagement before any data is collected. It records whether the scope covers a Group or a single Organization, the sector, the decision levels (Strategic Management — MS, Operational Management — MO, Operational Level — OP, or a custom level), the functions in scope, the focus (all training needs, Digital, AI or custom) and any custom criteria. It then identifies the stakeholders who will respond, has the scope validated by the Head of L&D and approved by the HR Director or the Consultant PM, and publishes it to questionnaire design and needs analysis. Any change after approval requires re-validation.

This root chain turns the approved Scope of Work into evidence. The L&D Analyst selects a template by focus and sector and elaborates the questionnaire by loading a template, generating questions with AI, or writing them manually; every AI-generated or AI-tailored question is validated by a human before distribution. RACSI roles are allocated to each section, with exactly one Accountable. The questionnaire is then distributed through the channels each stakeholder uses (Face-to-Face, Email, Hybrid or Custom), reminders follow a per-channel cadence, and responses are collected — offline for Face-to-Face, with later synchronisation. No response is stored without consent. Complete responses are consolidated into a tenant-scoped dataset that feeds the needs analysis, the diagnostic and the Training Engineering Report.
